title: artemisia vulgaris var. heterophylla
intro: Artemisia vulgaris var. heterophylla, commonly known as Southern Mugwort, is a variety of the Mugwort plant, belonging to the Asteraceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including aiding in digestion, reducing inflammation, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Southern Mugwort include stimulating circulation, reducing fever, and promoting sweating, making it a valued remedy for treating respiratory and gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and essential oils, such as thujone and borneol, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
